sourceFingerprintAlgorithm: sha256 over the covered paths in DECLARED ORDER; each path contributes <repo-relative path> NUL <64-hex sha256 of the file's RAW BYTES> NUL; per-file digest = script/m24/portability.ts sha256File() (node:crypto, no process spawn)
limitations: The byte-gated doc asserts repository-derived facts only; machine reality (realDbsScanned/realPairRows) is recorded here and is specific to the machine that ran this gate.
The drift gate compares the bytes on disk BEFORE writing, so the first run after a content change fails and regenerates; the run after that is the proof.
